evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 2 injury.
evidence.MCL: The contour of MCL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 2-3 injury
evidence.Medial Meniscus: linear high signal intensity in the body and posterior horn of medial meniscus with extension into the surface, in favor of tear of meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: linear high signal intensity in the body, anterior horn and posterior horn of lateral meniscus with extension into the surface, in favor of tear of meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Mild degeneration of knee joint with spur formation
evidence.Lateral OA: Mild degeneration of knee joint with spur formation
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion in popliteal fossa with a small recess of the knee joint capsule lies medially between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
evidence.Fracture: Depression with suspicious of cortical discontinuity at articular surface of posterior lateral tibia plateau with adjacent bone marrow edema, R/O bone contusion and occult lateral tibial plateau fracture.
